newsitem.title: USA: Millbrook starts Eastern proxy solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Millbrook starts Eastern proxy solicitation.

text.p: Millbrook Capital Management Inc said its MMI Investments LLC affiliate has begun soliciting proxies from the shareholders of record of Eastern Co.

The company said the proxy seeks to elect a slate of directors, who, if elected at the 1997 Eastern annual meeting, would propose measures to increase shareholder value. On February 6, Millbrook announced that MMI had submitted a slate of three nominees to the board of Eastern.

Millbrook, owner of about 6.61 percent of Eastern's common stock, said it intends to replace Eastern's incumbent nominees with three new directors committed to enhancing value for all Eastern shareholders. The Millbrook slate consists of Millbrook chairman John Dyson, its president Clay Lifflander, and George Scherer, president of B.W. Elliott Manufacturing Co.

"As major stockholders, we believe that Eastern has not been responsive to maximizing stockholder value. While refusing to entertain the sale of Eastern at any price, the management of Eastern has offered no alternative route to maximizing stockholder value in the face of the poor performance of the company and its stock price," Millbrook president Clay Lifflander said.
